It cites no data, analysis, or source for either claim.","evidence_quote":"Late deliveries are the single biggest reason customers churn, and fixing them would save the business millions every year.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite the churn attribution analysis and the savings model, or remove or soften the claims."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Customer phone contact without Privacy review","detail":"Agents will phone customers, which uses customer phone numbers, a personal-data contact detail. The policy requires a Privacy review covering purpose limitation and retention. The Reviews section records only contact center staffing.","evidence_quote":"Operations agents phone customers whose orders are running late to explain the delay and offer a reschedule.","citations":["policy-compliance#customer-location-and-personal-data"],"recommendation":"Complete and record a Privacy review (DPIA or privacy assessment) covering use of customer phone numbers for proactive outreach, including purpose limitation and retention."}]}
